title: Which take of each story-night sound to keep
question: Each animation the sleep plays now has sound under it, and the boot bloom has a chime. Five sounds are wired: a peck for the crow's strikes, treads, a servo and a seed scatter for the robot, and a soft rising chime under the bloom. Four of the five are free recordings (CC0); the chime is synthesized, because no free bell recording rises in pitch, and the moment needs a rise. Two or three alternates for each sit unwired in the title screen's Sound Test, next to the picks, so this is a listen rather than a design question. The video below is the game itself, recorded with its sound, so you can hear the five picks where they play.
why_now: The sounds ship with the story nights. Whatever you pick here is what players hear on the first crow night.

options.label: Keep the five wired picks (Recommended)
options.detail: The cleanest single take of each request. Nothing changes.

options.label: Keep the picks, but a plain decaying bell at boot
options.detail: Swap the rising chime for one of the three free bell recordings. A single ding under the bloom instead of a climb.

options.label: Swap one or more for an alternate from the Sound Test
options.detail: Name which. Each alternate is already in the game and in the credits, so a swap is one line.

attachments.caption: The three moments recorded from the running game with its own audio: the boot (the chime under the music fading up), the crow night (squawk, two pecks, the music ducked), the robot night (treads, servo, seed scatter). Turn the sound on.
